ranked.headline: Hormone and redox modules tune ABA, JA and ROS outputs in plant stress responses
ranked.summary: New Arabidopsis and crop studies map transcriptional, epigenetic and post-translational nodes that link ABA, JA and ROS to stress tolerance.

ranked.headline: Histology and spatial omics models infer molecular states and cell niches from tissue images
ranked.summary: Several preprints this week recover molecular, senescence and niche information from H&E and spatial transcriptomics using foundation and causal models.

ranked.headline: Nucleic-acid language models are being specialized, probed, and turned toward design
ranked.summary: New preprints extend DNA/RNA foundation models to niche genomes, methylation, ncRNA and RNA-RNA interactions, and test what post-training actually learns.

ranked.headline: MRI markers of brain structure and signal dynamics track development, aging and disorder
ranked.summary: Recent preprints use diffusion, morphometric and resting-state MRI to link brain variability and structure to age, sex, cognition and clinical traits.

ranked.headline: Sequence models and context-specific eQTLs sharpen noncoding variant-to-gene interpretation
ranked.summary: New preprints pair deep sequence models with ancestry-, drug- and tissue-resolved eQTL maps to link noncoding risk variants to effector genes and cell states.

ranked.headline: Compact, task-adapted sequence models add dynamics, structure and evolutionary context to protein prediction
ranked.summary: Eight preprints show protein and genomic language models being adapted with dynamics, structure and reference-based inputs for variant, enzyme and homology tasks.

ranked.headline: Trait and diversification dynamics across clades reflect selection, drift, niche lability and gene flow
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a Current Biology paper test selection, drift and environment as drivers of trait and lineage diversification across birds, lizards, insects, mammals and plants.

ranked.headline: Accessible QC, annotation and analysis tools for MS-based proteomics, lipidomics and metabolomics
ranked.summary: Seven preprints in one week pair open software with QC benchmarks across MS imaging, lipidomics, metabolomics, and low-input and single-cell proteomics.

ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics is extending to subcellular, single-cell, longitudinal and isoform-level readouts
ranked.summary: Seven preprints push spatial transcriptomics toward 3D subcellular embeddings, deconvolution, clonal mapping and live-tissue sampling, with tumour annotation and isoform work alongside.

ranked.headline: C. elegans longevity depends on context-specific stress, metabolic and neuroendocrine pathways
ranked.summary: Recent C. elegans work links lifespan to stress pathways, NAD+ remodeling, UPRmt signaling and midlife architectural change, with temperature and context effects.

ranked.headline: Omics across HD models, TDP-43, GBA1 and ALS map age-dependent molecular changes in neurodegeneration
ranked.summary: Six preprints apply proteomic, transcriptomic and variant-function profiling to age-dependent changes in Huntington, TDP-43, GBA1 and ALS systems.

ranked.headline: Omic profiling resolves Alzheimer's heterogeneity into cell-type and proteomic subtypes
ranked.summary: Preprints pair mouse single-nucleus atlases with human brain and CSF proteomics to resolve Alzheimer's disease into cell-type-specific and molecular subtypes.

ranked.headline: Assembly and alignment methods are being redesigned to reduce error propagation across sequence-analysis pipelines
ranked.summary: Six November preprints tackle error-prone steps in sequence reconstruction and search, from codon alignment to signal-level assembly and GPU RNA homology search.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomic and proteomic inferences prove contingent on compartment, depth, scoring and time
ranked.summary: Six preprints show that conclusions from omics data shift with evaluation depth, scoring method, cell composition or compartment, cautioning against uniform readouts.

ranked.headline: Structure- and ML-guided design of glue degraders and protein binders targeting interfaces and pockets
ranked.summary: Six preprints from mid-November 2026 pair rational molecular glue design with computational binder design and mutational mapping of drug-sensitive targets.

ranked.headline: Perturbation and chromatin profiling methods resolve dynamic regulatory responses at single-molecule and spatial scales
ranked.summary: Six preprints pair perturbation or differentiation with chromatin readouts, extending resolution from hub dynamics to single molecules and spatial context.

ranked.headline: Automated, scalable pipelines link neuronal identity, morphology and transcriptome across species
ranked.summary: Five new reports automate Patch-seq, atlas building, glomerular mapping and spatial transcript analysis, and a Drosophila study ties one isoform to connectome identity.

ranked.headline: Lineage, Wnt, Notch-SOX9 and tissue-architecture studies refine how early progenitors specify fates
ranked.summary: Five recent items probe progenitor fate and tissue organization across mouse, planarian, zebrafish and organoid models, from lineage tracing to Wnt and SOX9 programs.

ranked.headline: Models extract shared latent structure from heterogeneous neural data via alignment, geometry and plasticity
ranked.summary: Preprints and one paper offer latent-structure frameworks spanning cross-dataset alignment, digital twins, hyperbolic dynamics, plasticity clocks and subicular coding.

ranked.headline: Selective autophagy and trafficking pathways remodel organelles and clear damaged proteins under stress
ranked.summary: Five new reports show distinct stress-triggered quality-control routes acting on organelle contacts, peroxisomes, lysosomes, endosomes and extracellular proteins.

ranked.headline: Splicing timing and mRNP maturation shape RNA processing across model systems
ranked.summary: Recent work links splicing timing, mRNP assembly and snRNA processing to developmental transitions and abscission.

ranked.headline: Spatial and single-cell profiling links aging to cell type-specific senescence programs
ranked.summary: Spatially resolved and single-cell studies now resolve senescence and aging programs within specific human and mouse tissue cell types.

ranked.headline: Diet and Dennd5b status reshape chylomicron lipid export and intestinal and hepatic metabolism
ranked.summary: Lipidomic and transcriptomic readouts now resolve diet-driven lipid export, hepatic reprogramming, and gut-brain signaling across mouse and canine systems.

ranked.headline: Large haploblocks and contingency shape rapid adaptation during evolutionary rescue
ranked.summary: Recent preprints dissect the genomic basis of rapid adaptation, from evolutionary rescue in beetles and flies to selection on archaic human variation.

ranked.headline: Transformer and graph models learn cell and gene representations from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Five mid-November 2026 preprints apply transformer, graph, and flow-matching models to single-cell multi-omics and perturbation prediction.

ranked.headline: NGLY1 deficiency and arrayed Perturb-seq reveal regulators of microglial development
ranked.summary: Isogenic stem cell models and arrayed Perturb-seq now map genetic control of microglial state and function.

ranked.headline: Mutational signatures resolved jointly across SBS, DBS and indel classes
ranked.summary: Joint multimodal modelling and sequence-based prediction now resolve mutational processes across cancer genomes and normal tissues.

ranked.headline: Translation is reprogrammed by tRNA pools, ribosome composition, and pausing
ranked.summary: Single-cell, nascent-proteome, and yeast studies now link tRNA abundance and ribosome state to selective translational control.

ranked.headline: Cell-type-specific molecular changes in human and mouse models of brain disorders
ranked.summary: Cell-type-resolved profiling of FMRP loss, 22q11.2 deletion neurons and SETX knockout motor neurons refines disease mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Higher-order assemblies organize membranes from mitochondria to plasma membrane wounds
ranked.summary: Recent in situ, structural, and in vivo studies resolve how multisubunit assemblies remodel membranes in native and developmental contexts.

ranked.headline: Defined circuits link visual input to direction, depth, altitude, and gain control
ranked.summary: Recent connectome and in vivo recordings resolve specific circuit elements underlying visual computations and the behaviors they drive.

ranked.headline: H3K4 and DNA methylation shield regulatory elements from Polycomb silencing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications dissect how histone and DNA methylation marks interface with Polycomb silencing during development and chromatin maintenance.

ranked.headline: Myelination and network organization shift in 22q11.2 and autism-linked models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie oligodendroglial defects to interneuron hypomyelination and altered network organization in neurodevelopmental models.

ranked.headline: Language models are being built for accurate, interpretable biological inference
ranked.summary: Four preprints pair LLM components with explicit evidence retrieval or validation to improve accuracy and interpretability across diverse biological tasks.

ranked.headline: Mechanical forces shape Drosophila wing eversion, spindle positioning, and mitotic timing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints link tissue mechanics and centrosome-generated forces to morphogenesis, division timing, and axial organ geometry.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs enable haplotype-resolved read phasing and germline allele discovery
ranked.summary: Four November 2026 preprints apply pangenome graph references to read phasing, long-read mapping, diploid inference, and TCR germline discovery.

ranked.headline: Chaperones and coactivator modules tune transcription in mammalian and yeast systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints dissect how chaperone-like factors, coactivator assembly, and TFIID sequestration shape transcriptional output.

ranked.headline: Phosphorylation switches, fibroblast programs and matrix cores in vascular remodelling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints link endothelial phosphorylation switches, perivascular stromal support and conserved fibrosis matrix programs to tissue integrity.

ranked.headline: AAV9 and retrograde AAV-KP vectors enable cell-specific gene transfer in mouse kidney
ranked.summary: Wild-type AAV9 and barcoded AAV-KP capsid screens now permit targeted renal transduction in mice, including macula densa cells.

ranked.headline: eDNA metabarcoding tracks marine taxa; freezing samples alters inferred richness
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair eDNA monitoring with sample-handling tests and integrative taxonomy to refine marine biodiversity inference.
